description: CCW session tracking: injects skill context on each prompt and records coordinator progress when a turn ends. Does nothing when the ccw CLI isn’t installed.

hooks.command: command -v ccw >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ccw hook template exec ccw-coordinator-skill-context --stdin
command -v ccw >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ccw hook template exec ccw-coordinator-tracker --stdin
